title: DOCOMO SMTB Net Bank: WEB course closed to new pre-screening applications
summary: The bank confirms a 30 October closure. Applicants who submitted before the cutoff can continue processing through the WEB course.

takeaways.text: Check application-channel availability before relying on a displayed mortgage rate.

sections.heading: What the bank confirms
sections.text: The WEB course support page says new pre-screening applications ended on 30 October 2026. Applicants who submitted before the cutoff may continue through that course.

sections.heading: What to confirm next
sections.text: Existing applicants should confirm their remaining deadlines with the bank. This notice does not establish closure of every mortgage channel or changed terms for existing borrowers.

sections.heading: Dates and limits
sections.text: This is a retrospective verification on 8 November, not a same-day announcement. The event date is 30 October, Japan time. The page states no publication/update date or exact cutoff time. Rates, eligibility, fees and rewards are not established here.
